items.headline: Bear of the Day: Albemarle Corporation (ALB)
items.snippet: Albemarle's downward earnings revisions earn the stock a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell). ALB's earnings outlook dropped 13% for Q3 and 36% for the fourth quarter since its Q2 release.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. Argus believes the supply and demand trends in the lithium market appear poised to improve into 2027.
